charges.label: Base freight (per km by billed weight band)
charges.quote: up to and including 500 kg: ₹18.00 per km; 501 kg to 2,000 kg: ₹24.00 per km. Consignments above 2,000 kg are quoted case by case and are outside this rate card.

charges.label: Express service premium (15% of base freight)
charges.quote: Express service, where booked, carries a premium of 15% of the base freight.

charges.label: Fuel surcharge (12% of base freight plus express premium)
charges.quote: A fuel surcharge of 12% applies to the freight charge (base freight plus express premium, where applicable).

charges.label: Residential delivery (flat per consignment)
charges.quote: Residential delivery (consignee address is a residence, or the booking is flagged residential): ₹250.00 flat per consignment.

document_rules.rule: Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices; each references the original consignment note number and states the invoice it corrects.
Billing disputes must be raised within 45 days of invoice date; disputed line items are payable only on resolution, undisputed items remain due.
Carrier invoices fortnightly; payment due 30 days from invoice date.
Any service outside the accessorial schedule requires the Customer's prior written agreement, evidenced by a rate confirmation referencing this agreement.

ambiguities.description: Weight bands are 'up to and including 500 kg' and '501 kg to 2,000 kg'; billed weights strictly between 500 and 501 kg (e.g. 500.5 kg) fall in neither band, so the per-km rate is undetermined.

notes: Residential charge applies when special_handling contains 'residential'; §4 also covers consignees whose address is a residence without the flag, which the shipment record cannot express. Fuel surcharge applies to base freight + express premium only, not to the residential charge. No minimum charge, no chargeable-weight rule, no volume discount in the contract. Services: §2 names express as optional ('where booked'); standard is the implied default.
